title: Divergent Progression Forked
description:
A fork from Divergent Progression by 
BlueStaggo to change some features for my modpack.
body:
- All features from the original mod (https://github.com/BlueStaggo/divergent-progression/tree/main)
- Added a config file
- Can change anvil break chance when repairing in config
- Can blacklist certain item to prevent it to have broken tag when durability turn into 0

- Added stone tools back, requiring stone to craft
- Added Copper Armors, weaker than chainmail
-  Flint Tools now replace wooden tools 
-  Changed leather armors recipe to make it significantly easier to craft early game
